What degraded

  • The deck shipped at the round cap with a median of 7.01, 0.99 under the 8.0 top rung, and the craft floor stood down with the art median at 6.5.
  • Frame 6's relief still reads as a tray and was named in all three rounds. It was not recomposed this run.
  • The flow critic's deck-level fault, nine of nine frames on one type-on-top skeleton, was not repaired.
  • 19 record items carry a dated unconfirmed line instead of a stamp, behind refusing hosts.
  • The Bottleneck Scanner's D1 progress was not checked. This session has no access to it.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it Tesla's Texas vehicle and Megapack rows read Production. The robot row reads Construction, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

Tesla's humanoid robot production began in California.

Its row under Tesla's Texas label reads Construction, with no capacity figure. Tesla defines construction as factory and infrastructure buildout plus tool installation. Optimus production began on high volume lines in Fremont.

The vehicle and Megapack rows under the same label read Production. Model Y sits at more than 375,000 a year. The Cybertruck and the Cybercab sit at more than 125,000 each. Megapack sits at 50 GWh.

The table measures installed capacity. Tesla's own footnote says that is not the current production rate. It ties production rates to uptime, component supply, downtime for factory upgrades, regulation and other factors. The update gives no count of Cybercabs built.

How much did Tesla actually make in Texas in the third quarter?

#Tesla #Optimus #Megapack

The machine changed itself

  • The kit now has a structural steel frame whose columns read as real W sections
    The judges asked for it on no. 59's flat red columns in all three rounds. It is proven on frame 7's own camera.
  • print_ban now fails any relief that casts almost no shadow
    Six reliefs on four decks this week did, and the judges called every one flat. The floor was measured once on those decks and applies from tomorrow.
  • Escalated for a maintainer in UPGRADE_BACKLOG under October 24th
    A GATE_LESSONS entry for that gate, a matching warning inside txbench.js, and one JSON shape for the scorer cards, all on human lane or protected paths.
  • Deferred with reasons
    A kit cloth cover for vehicles, type sitting on the art, and missing ground contact.

Every change is logged in ledger/carousel/upgrades.json.

Notes

Carousel no. 59 is Tesla's own Q3 2026 capacity table. Its Texas vehicle and Megapack rows read Production. Its Optimus row reads Construction with no capacity figure, and robot production began in Fremont. It is drawn as a plant wall at night with four lit bays and one dark bay. It shipped at the round cap after three panel rounds, at a median of 7.01, 0.99 under the 8.0 top rung. Rounds 1 and 2 each found real hard fails, and all were repaired: - the cover's "Texas rows" universal over two Early Ramp rows - a covered car drawn with the mirrors c42 says it lacks - the word "still" in the web edition's dek The final round has no hard fail. Its weakest frames are 6 (a relief that reads as a tray), 8 (the covered car) and 7 (flat steel). Story and stakes are low on every card, because the deck names no county, deadline or next step. The record: 138 items re-verified, tx-2026-0230 admitted, 19 items carry a dated unconfirmed line behind refusing hosts. The Bottleneck Scanner was not checked. The weekly machine pass ran. It added a kit structural frame and a print_ban floor for reliefs that cast almost no shadow. Permission waits, interim Phase 17 reading: 66 of 1,876 calls waited 1 to 31 seconds each, 350 seconds in all, and nothing stalled. The no-stall hook was armed and refused nothing. The final reading is taken after the merge.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
